schemaVersion.description: MCP I/O schema version of this input. Optional; when present it must be 1.

artifact.description: The emitted context-rule.json document (as synthesize returns in contextRule). Alternative to artifactPath.

account.description: The OpenZeppelin smart account (C…) to read.

installLog.description: A policywright install log; when given, valid_until is compared with what the install computed.

installLogPath.description: Path to a policywright install log (alternative to installLog).

network.description: Stellar network. Defaults to the server configuration (POLICYWRIGHT_NETWORK, testnet).

rpcUrl.description: Soroban RPC endpoint override for this call. Defaults to the server configuration (POLICYWRIGHT_RPC_URL) or the public endpoint for the network.
